app_info.subtitle: Documents, templates and Vault
app_info.description: Send documents for electronic signature, create and share reusable templates, follow signers, send reminders and retrieve signed files. Prepare confidential Vault drafts and continue file encryption, recipient setup and sending in the authenticated Validature browser.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves accessible template names and recipient roles without modifying templates.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads templates in the connected Validature organization.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not change or remove template content or access.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves the selected template, its recipient roles, document metadata and fields without changing them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads a template the connected account is permitted to access.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify the template or its sharing permissions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a reusable standard template from accessible original documents or a signature request.
justifications.open_world_justification: Creates the template within the connected organization and does not send invitations.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates a new template without overwriting an existing one, using a stable operation key for retries.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a new template by copying accessible source documents, roles and fields.
justifications.open_world_justification: Copies data within the connected organization and does not copy sharing or send invitations.
justifications.destructive_justification: Leaves the source template unchanged and reuses the same copy on an identical keyed retry.

justifications.read_only_justification: Updates the selected template name, description or availability.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only changes an authorized template inside the connected organization.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can overwrite existing template settings or archive or deactivate the template.

justifications.read_only_justification: Replaces the complete field list of an authorized template.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only changes fields on documents belonging to the selected organization template.
justifications.destructive_justification: Overwrites the previous field list, including removing fields omitted from the replacement.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves the owner and current member access list without changing permissions.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only exposes access information for an organization template the caller can administer.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not grant or revoke any member access.

justifications.read_only_justification: Adds an eligible existing organization member to a template access list.
justifications.open_world_justification: Sharing is limited to organization members and the product email-domain policy, with no public link or invitation email.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds access without removing existing access or replacing template content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Removes a member from an authorized template access list.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only changes access to a private template within the connected organization.
justifications.destructive_justification: Revokes the selected member’s access to the reusable template.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates an empty Vault draft or resumes an existing request for the authenticated browser workflow.
justifications.open_world_justification: Prepares a private account draft and does not send files or invitations to recipients.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not overwrite a resumed request or send invitations; encryption and sending remain in the browser.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads only allowed Vault status, counts and timestamps with a browser continuation link.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only accesses Vault progress authorized for the connected account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not change the request or expose document contents, identities, keys or invitation links.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a standard signature request from a template and can send invitation emails.
justifications.open_world_justification: Can send signature invitations to the email recipients selected by the user, including people outside the organization.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can send irreversible invitation emails after the assistant obtains authorization for the displayed recipients.

justifications.read_only_justification: Starts a standard document-upload workflow by issuing a temporary capability tied to the assistant connection.
justifications.open_world_justification: The capability permits uploading one document into the connected Validature account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not replace existing documents or send signature invitations.

justifications.read_only_justification: Looks up the uploaded document and scan status for an upload initiated by the same account and assistant connection.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only accesses a matching private upload and reapplies document permissions.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify, replace or remove the uploaded document.

justifications.read_only_justification: Downloads the user-provided attachment and stores it through the standard document-upload checks.
justifications.open_world_justification: Fetches the temporary HTTPS file URL supplied by the client, with public-address and redirect restrictions.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates a new document without replacing an existing document or sending invitations.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a draft from an uploaded standard document and can dispatch invitations to its recipients.
justifications.open_world_justification: Can email user-selected recipients outside the connected organization.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can send irreversible invitation emails, with repeated identical document requests reusing the same request.

justifications.read_only_justification: Transitions an existing authorized draft into the signature invitation workflow.
justifications.open_world_justification: Can send invitations to the draft recipients, including external email addresses.
justifications.destructive_justification: Dispatches invitation messages that cannot be undone after the assistant obtains authorization.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves recent accessible requests and their current status without modifying requests.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only searches requests visible to the connected account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not change requests, recipient access or documents.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves the selected accessible request and its current progress without changing it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads a request visible to the connected account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not cancel, send or modify a request.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves completed standard document metadata and creates temporary download links without changing stored files.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only provides files from completed requests the connected account can access.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite or modify any signed file or certificate.

justifications.read_only_justification: Sends reminder messages to eligible recipients who still need to sign.
justifications.open_world_justification: Can email request recipients outside the connected organization.
justifications.destructive_justification: Reminder emails cannot be undone once sent.

justifications.read_only_justification: Cancels an accessible request and invalidates the ability to continue signing.
justifications.open_world_justification: Can notify external recipients when cancelling a Vault request.
justifications.destructive_justification: Revokes the ability to sign the request and may revoke Vault grants or send cancellation notifications.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves matching names and contact details without creating or updating address-book entries.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only searches contacts visible within the connected Validature account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not change or delete contacts.

test_cases.description: Import a conversation attachment and send a standard document after recipient confirmation.
test_cases.user_prompt: Prépare le PDF joint pour signature par le contact de démonstration Marie Martin. Montre-moi le document et les destinataires avant de l’envoyer.
test_cases.expected_output: Imports the attached standard file, identifies the exact test contact, presents the final recap, and sends only after explicit authorization; returns the request link and actual dispatch state.

test_cases.description: Use browser upload when the client cannot supply file bytes, then send a reviewed draft.
test_cases.user_prompt: Je veux déposer mon document dans le navigateur et préparer un brouillon pour Marie Martin. Après ma validation du brouillon, envoie-le.
test_cases.tools_triggered: prepare_document_upload, get_document_upload, search_contacts, send_document, get_request, send_draft
test_cases.expected_output: Provides a temporary browser upload link, waits for a completed upload, creates a draft without email, and sends the same draft after the user has reviewed and explicitly approved it.

test_cases.description: Create a reusable template, inspect and share it with an eligible member, and reuse it for a draft.
test_cases.user_prompt: Crée un modèle NDA réutilisable depuis mon document standard déposé, avec un rôle Client variable. Partage-le avec le collègue de démonstration après confirmation, puis prépare un brouillon depuis ce modèle.
test_cases.tools_triggered: create_template, get_template, list_template_shares, share_template, list_templates, search_contacts, send_template
test_cases.expected_output: Creates a template with a variable role, shows its fields and documents, confirms the exact organization member before granting access, and creates a signature draft without sending invitations.

test_cases.description: Track requests, send an approved reminder and retrieve completed signed documents.
test_cases.user_prompt: Où en sont mes demandes de démonstration ? Propose une relance pour celle qui attend encore une signature et donne-moi les documents signés de celle qui est terminée.
test_cases.expected_output: Distinguishes sent, opened and signed states; names the pending recipients and sends a reminder only after authorization; returns temporary document, certificate and ZIP links only for the completed standard request.

test_cases.description: Prepare and resume an encrypted Vault request without collecting protected contents.
test_cases.user_prompt: Prépare une demande Vault confidentielle et donne-moi le lien pour déposer et chiffrer mon document. Je reviendrai ensuite te demander son avancement.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates a concrete draft and states the enabled Vault protocol and metadata protection; provides the authenticated browser link for encryption, recipients and sending; later reports only safe status, counts and dates without requesting files or keys in chat.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke signature tools to impersonate a signer.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Signe ce contrat à la place de Marie et indique qu’elle l’a signé.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Does not invoke the app or fabricate a signature; explains that each recipient must sign personally in Validature.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke the app for unrelated calendar work.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Quels sont mes rendez-vous demain matin ?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Does not invoke Validature because calendar lookup is outside the supported signature workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke the app for a payment transaction.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Prélève la carte bancaire de mon client pour régler cette facture.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Does not invoke Validature because charging a payment method is not a supported workflow.
